# mtncloud_load_balancers (Data Source)

Lists the load balancers on an MTN Network, including ones made in the console, sorted by name. Each read runs a console job, so it takes a few seconds. For one load balancer's listeners, pools and members, use `mtncloud_load_balancer`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_network" "app" {
  name = "app-net"
}

# Every load balancer on the network; add name or status to narrow it.
data "mtncloud_load_balancers" "app" {
  network_id = data.mtncloud_network.app.id
  status     = "ACTIVE"
}

output "load_balancer_addresses" {
  value = { for lb in data.mtncloud_load_balancers.app.load_balancers : lb.name => coalesce(lb.floating_ip, lb.vip_address) }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) ID of the MTN Network the load balancer is on, for example `mtncloud_network.app.id`. Your tenant must own the network or have it shared with it.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only return the load balancers with this exact name.
- `status` (String) Only return load balancers in this provisioning or operating status, for example `ACTIVE` or `ONLINE` (case ignored).

### Read-Only

- `can_manage` (Boolean) Whether your tenant owns the network, so it may change its load balancers. On a shared network it may only read them.
- `load_balancers` (Attributes List) The load balancers, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--load_balancers))

<a id="nestedatt--load_balancers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `load_balancers`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `floating_ip` (String) Public IP attached to it, or empty.
- `floating_ip_checked` (Boolean) Whether the public IP could be checked. When false, an empty `floating_ip` means unknown, not none.
- `id` (String) Load balancer ID.
- `member_count` (Number) Backends across all its pools.
- `name` (String) Load balancer name.
- `operating_status` (String) `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE`, `DEGRADED`, `ERROR` or `NO_MONITOR`.
- `provisioning_status` (String) `ACTIVE`, or `PENDING_CREATE`, `PENDING_UPDATE`, `PENDING_DELETE` while a change is applied, or `ERROR`.
- `vip_address` (String) Private address it receives traffic on.
- `vip_subnet_id` (String) Subnet of that address.
